purpose: Document food, drink, tableware, and pantry props by family, status tier, style, visible anatomy, serving/storage state, geometry terms, Blender tool IDs, drawing UI tags, source fields, operator checks, and lore hooks.

food_drink_status_tiers.social_read: Plain survival food, guard ration, prisoner food, camp food, or emergency stores.
Everyday food and drink for taverns, kitchens, barracks, markets, and common halls.
Ordered shared meals, plain table service, disciplined storage, and repetitive serving.
Goods for sale, baskets, sacks, jars, fresh produce, spices, and visible exchange value.
High-status table service, polished vessels, arranged platters, wine, meat, and display.
Offering food, feast markers, holy-day bread, ceremonial drink, or symbolic vessel props.
Portable food and drink for roads, scouting, messengers, and survival scenes.
Abandoned kitchens, rotten stores, spilled food, dried remains, cracked vessels, and stale clutter.

food_drink_families.core_function: Staple food, rations, trenchers, sacks, flour, market goods, and table portions.
Fresh, market, garden, travel, and spoiled organic food clutter.
Cheese wheels, wedges, cut faces, cloth-wrapped dairy, and table/pantry proteins.
Cooked, preserved, served, market, banquet, and ruin remains for kitchens and halls.
Liquid or semi-liquid meals in bowls, cauldrons, tavern dishes, and refectory settings.
Beer, wine, water, jugs, goblets, bottles, cups, flasks, and liquid-state props.
Plates, trenchers, platters, bowls, goblets, tankards, and serving surfaces that organize meals.
Sacks, jars, bottles, sealed spices, labeled goods, and store-room clutter.

source_support.label: Britannica bread
source_support.support_summary: Supports bread as a staple baked food with varied forms including flat, raised, round, and scored loaves.

anatomy_parts.geometry_role: cut or broken soft interior hint
material role for pale powder on surface

craft_sequence: Build a low rounded body from a simple profile.
Add crust scores as shallow relief or dark line details.
Add optional cut crumb face for half-loaf variants.
Use material slots for crust, crumb, and flour dust.
Declare serving or ration state separately from geometry.
food_drink_items.serving_mechanics: The loaf can be a whole table item, cut portion, ration, or offering; portion state is source data.
operator_checks: Does it read as bread without texture?
Are crust scores shallow enough for low-poly editability?
Is cut/whole state source-owned?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Names loaf body, crust score, crumb edge, flour dust, and portion state.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: A loaf tells whether a room was fed, starved, or only staged for ceremony.
